description: Mohamed Aboobakar Ibrahim v. Hon. Attorney General Mohamed Aboobakar Ibrahim v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. M.M.A. Gaffoor, J
parties: Mohamed Aboobakar Ibrahim v. Hon. Attorney General Mohamed Aboobakar Ibrahim v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Criminal appeal – Rape charge – Conviction for grave sexual abuse instead of indicted offence – Amendment/substitution of charge after closure of prosecution and defence cases – Distinction between rape and grave sexual abuse – Grave sexual abuse not a lesser offence of rape – Cognate offences with distinct ingredients – Accused not informed of new charge – Denial of opportunity to defend – Grave procedural irregularity – Prejudice to accused – Proviso relating to failure of justice not applicable – Conviction and sentence set aside – Retrial ordered. K.K. Wickramasinghe J. agreed.
legistation: Penal Code – section 364(2)(e) and provisions relating to grave sexual abuse, referred to as section 365/365B in the judgment, as amended by Act No. 22 of 1995; Code of Criminal Procedure Act – sections 175, 177, 178 and 334; Constitution – Article 138.
